p.i:
——cui vertice fulgens
Triplex crista jubas effundit crine Sueuo.

main_text.p: Cui Sueuum siue Germanicum etiam crinem adfingit, quia scilicet ille Flaminius triumphauerat de Gallis, quos cum Germanis confundi à poëtis id ævi, haud novum. Aliter ego quidem Silium non intellego. Est & in eodem Silio, de Marcello:

p.i:
Circumstant rapidi juvenes, aptántque frementi
Sanguineas de more jubas.

main_text.p: Et cum recogito, etiam in lapidibus vidi, etsi minus sæpè.

„ Pulcher is aspectus, hostiqueformidolosus.] In re tenui momentum ad pugnam & victoriam ostendit: & causâ duplici, inquit, bonæ cristæ. siue quòd vir maior, Vsus cristarum.& animo quoque crescit: siue quòd hosti terrorem magis præbet. Vtrumque verum, & nescio quo naturæ ductu ubique terrarum ferè bellatores hoc adfectant. Orientales passim, atque etiam rudes isti in novo orbe. Maiores nostri studiosè, etsi nos vulgò omisimus: studiosè? imò ambitiosè, & hinc insignia ista familiarum tam varia, quis superbimus. Primi auctores rei Cares, Innuento-res crista.In Clio. quod scriptores adnotarunt. ut Herodotus: Ἐπὶ τὰ κεφα-λέα λόφυς ἐπιδέεσθαι κᾶρες εἰσιν οἱ καταδεξάντες: In galeis cristas illigare Cares sunt qui ostenderunt. Strabo: Lib. xiiii.Τᾶ δὲ ὥσπερ [?] τὰ σημαντικὰ ζῴου τὰ τε ὄχανα ποιεῖσθαι τεχνήεια, καὶ τὰ [?] ἐπίσημα καὶ σὺν λόφυς: Studÿsui ergarem bellicam testimonia adferunt scutorum ansas, & insignia & cristas.

page.notes: Left strip is the edge of the neighbouring page and was excluded. The first line "Mezentio:" continues a quotation from the previous page and is marked cont="true". Greek is transcribed from a difficult, partly blurred scan; the Herodotus line break (κεφα-/λέα) is as printed, and the readings marked [?] are doubtful. The Strabo first line and the ending of the Greek are uncertain. The "Lib. vii." and "Lib. xiiii." notes are read as printed in small roman capitals. Verse lines were set in italic and each stanza kept as one paragraph. Long s was normalised to s, i/j and u/v adjusted as per the rules.
